subject: CONTROL clause
notes: The one grammar rule accepts both spellings - (CONTROL IS? | CONTROLS ARE?) - and nothing downstream can tell them apart, so they are synonyms by construction. Witnessed both ways: rw_suppress writes CONTROL IS, pb205_control_ref_mod writes CONTROLS ARE. kb/Work PB688 (2026-09-05): the golden moved from tests/conformance/2002 to tests/conformance/2023 - it observes the report by re-reading the report file through ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL, which is a COBOL-2023 introduction (12.4.5.10.3 GR2; the Foreword's main-changes list over ISO/IEC 1989:2014), so the program is not expressible at 2002. The RULE's editions are unchanged.
